newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SHARES CONTINUE TO FALL, GAINS NOT SEEN.
newsitem.headline: SHARES CONTINUE TO FALL, GAINS NOT SEEN.

text.p: * Bears continued to bite big chunks out of Lithuanian share prices on Friday, leaving most dealers in a gloomy mood.
* Siauliu Bank's four-session bull run skidded to a halt as its price eased to 100.00 litas from 102.40 litas.
* Vilniaus Bank was one of the session's few gainers, rising to 232.00 litas from 227.00 litas.
Lithuanian shares continued to fall on Friday, leaving local dealers in a gloomy mood.
"Serious investors are only examining the market now...it won't pick up before summer," said Kestutis Kupsys of brokerage firm Mendes Prior Europe.
Vilniaus Bank was one of the few shares to gain, rising ti 232.00 litas from 227.00 litas.
Siauliu Bank's four-session bull run, sparked by Hermis Bank's intention to acquire 51 percent of its shares, came to a halt as it eased to 100.00 litas from 102.40 litas.
